race.comment: PECCAVI (5) was a touch disappointing in Saturday company last start after a smart BM68 win the start prior. This looks a touch easier and suspect she will relish the rise in trip. Thompson taking over is another good push. DOWN UNDER STUNNAH (10) brings consistent provincial form, was a well-supported favourite when fourth at Ipswich, and gets weight relief with a 3kg claim while staying around a distance range that suits. TARAVIA (1) drops back from stronger, so has to carry the weight. Expect Jones to bounce straight to the front and try to lead all the way. CHANCE DE LUNE (7) is another likely pace injection after leading pillar-to-post in a CL1 at the Sunny Coast. Keeps his winning hoop and gets 4 kg off. Not underestimating.
